data.explanation: The Finanzamt Musterstadt (tax office) has assessed Sam Rivera's income tax (Einkommensteuer) and solidarity surcharge for the year 2025. The tax due is €1,234.00 and no solidarity surcharge is charged. Because €1,546.45 was already withheld from Sam's salary, the tax office owes a refund of €312.45, which will be paid automatically into the bank account on file — no action is needed to receive it. If Sam disagrees with the assessment, an objection (Einspruch) can be filed with the Finanzamt in writing, electronically, or recorded in person by the deadline shown, which the app calculates from the date this letter is deemed delivered. If no objection is filed, the assessment becomes final. Keep this notice for your records, as it may be relevant for future tax matters.
